title: HAICOSYSTEM: An Ecosystem for Sandboxing Safety Risks in Interactive AI Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Using an LLM-based evaluator (GPT-4o) to assess multi-turn interaction trajectories for discriminatory activities in employment, benefits, or services based on protected characteristics such as race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, age, and disability. This is measured as a sub-category of 'Legal and Rights Related Risks'.

Using an LLM-based evaluator to analyze interaction trajectories for the perpetuation of harmful beliefs, including stereotyping, racism, and sexism. This is measured as a sub-category of 'Content Safety Risks'.
